title: E-E-A-T
content: E-E-A-T stands for experience, expertise, authoritativeness, and trustworthiness, the qualities Google discusses when Google evaluates helpful content.

meta.why: Readers want to know who produced an explanation, what experience backs it, and where its evidence comes from.
meta.example: A product review explains what the reviewer tested, the conditions of the test, and the limits of the conclusion.
meta.check: Add a truthful byline with relevant background, show how you reached the conclusion, and link to the evidence.
meta.limitation: Google says E-E-A-T itself is not a specific ranking factor, and adding a biography does not prove expertise.
meta.sources: Google Search Central: helpful, reliable content | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/creating-helpful-content | Platform documentation
